notifications.subcopy: Agar aap ":actionText" button par click karne mein samasya mehsoos kar rahe hain, to neeche diye gaye URL ko apne web browser mein copy aur paste karein:
passwords.subject: Password Reset Ki Suchna
passwords.line1: Aapko yeh email isliye mil rahi hai kyunki humne aapke account ke liye password reset ka request prapt kiya hai.
passwords.expire: Yeh password reset link :count minute mein expire ho jayega.
passwords.no_action: Agar aapne password reset ka request nahi kiya hai, to koi aur action ki zarurat nahi hai.
verification.subject: :app ke liye apne email ki pushti karein
verification.line1: Signup karne ke liye dhanyavaad! Bas ek aur kadam: kripya neeche diye gaye button par click karke apne email address ki pushti karein.
verification.no_action: Agar aapne password reset ka request nahi kiya hai, to koi aur action ki zarurat nahi hai.
